short_notes: ‣ TONS of new updates to Grok Code! See the full update notes to read all of them
long_notes:
Hi guys! I’ve done a ton of work on Grok Code (with the help of AI), and I’ve added so many new features and fixed bugs! This version has been ready to post since September 7, but Cloudfare was blocking me because I unintentionally included raw HTML tags in this description. Here’s everything new:

• Workspace is now saved in the URL hash (#gc1, gzip). Reload the same tab and files, chat, model, spend, and undo come back. A fresh Shortcut run is still empty main.js.
• Optional Grok 4.6 model with Low / Medium / High / Extra High reasoning. Default is still Grok Build 0.1.
• Built-in web search and Python (code interpreter), with tool chips, citations, and a details popover.
• Chat is compacted every 8 turns so long threads stay cheaper. Reasoning is stored encrypted so compact still works.
• You can stop a running reply (old version only greyed out Send).
• Added 12 new keyboard shortcuts using the Control key, plus a panel listing them. Old only had save / toggle chat / undo / redo. New adds Ctrl+R for reasoning, focus editor/input, new file, clear chat, etc.
• Status bar now shows used storage out of 32 MB total, API spend, and status indicator that turns red if the xAI key is missing, invalid, disabled, or blocked.
• Phone opens on the editor. Compact chips sit on the right with space before the trash; model/reasoning menus are centered.
• Mac/iPad: chat starts at 500px (was 450) and you can drag the left edge to adjust the size. Floor is 440px so buttons don’t wrap.

Safer chat and edits
• Only complete `<edit>` blocks in Grok’s reply change the file. Reasoning “edits” are ignored (old applied those too).
• Incomplete edits are hidden while they stream; they don’t show as broken tags in the thread.
• Raw HTML in a reply is shown as text, so it can’t wreck the chat anymore. Markdown and fences still work.
• Nested backticks (JS template literals) highlight as one inline span.
• HTML files highlight `<script>` / `<style>` properly instead of going black/bold.
• Streaming updates the bubble in place instead of rebuilding it every token (no flicker).
• One user bubble + one assistant bubble with tool chips. The API output array is kept for replay, not dumped as extra messages.

UI polish 
• Title Grok AI Assistant (was “AI Assistant”).
• Empty-state copy mentions Build vs 4.6, web search, and code execution.
• Markdown tables and highlighted code text, teal links, updated syntax colors, fixed import icon, reasoning as a real panel instead of stripped bullets, and more.

I hope everyone enjoys this ginormous new experience!
